acceptance: insert before a range shifts it: given [{start:6,end:11,color:'#e03131'}], shiftRangesForEdit from 'hello world' to 'XXhello world', expect [{start:8,end:13,color:'#e03131'}]

insert at a range start shifts it, at its end leaves it: given [{start:2,end:4,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,2,0,1) and shiftRangesForSplice(r,4,0,1), expect [{start:3,end:5,...}] and [{start:2,end:4,...}]
insert inside a range grows it: given [{start:2,end:6,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,4,0,3), expect [{start:2,end:9,color:'red'}]
delete inside a range shrinks it: given [{start:2,end:8,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,3,2,0), expect [{start:2,end:6,color:'red'}]
delete across a boundary trims the range: given [{start:4,end:8,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,2,4,0) and shiftRangesForSplice(r,6,4,0), expect [{start:2,end:4,...}] and [{start:4,end:6,...}]
delete covering a range removes it: given [{start:4,end:6,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,3,5,0), expect []
edit after a range leaves it alone: given [{start:0,end:5,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForEdit from 'hello world' to 'hello worlds', expect deep-equal [{start:0,end:5,color:'red'}]

unchanged text or no ranges returns the same reference: given ranges array r; shiftRangesForEdit(r,'abc','abc'), shiftRangesForEdit([],'a','b'), shiftRangesForEdit(undefined,'a','b'), expect toBe r, toBe the same [] instance, undefined

applyStyleToRange splits an existing range: given [{start:0,end:10,color:'red'}], applyStyleToRange(r,3,6,{backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}), expect [{0,3,color red},{3,6,color red,backgroundColor #ffec99},{6,10,color red}]
applyStyleToRange fills gaps and merges equal neighbours: given [{start:0,end:2,color:'red'},{start:5,end:7,color:'red'}], applyStyleToRange(r,2,5,{color:'red'}), expect [{start:0,end:7,color:'red'}]

applyStyleToRange clears a style with null: given [{start:0,end:4,color:'red',backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}], applyStyleToRange(r,0,4,{backgroundColor:null}) then {color:null}, expect [{start:0,end:4,color:'red'}] then []
applyStyleToRange with an empty span changes nothing: given r, applyStyleToRange(r,3,3,{color:'blue'}), expect deep-equal normalizeRanges(r)

normalizeRanges sorts, drops invalid and resolves overlaps: given [{start:5,end:9,color:'a'},{start:2,end:2,color:'b'},{start:0,end:6,color:'c'},{start:9,end:10}], expect [{start:0,end:6,color:'c'},{start:6,end:9,color:'a'}]

clampRanges clamps to the text length: given [{start:-3,end:4,color:'a'},{start:8,end:20,color:'b'},{start:12,end:15,color:'c'}], length 10, expect [{start:0,end:4,color:'a'},{start:8,end:10,color:'b'}]

unwrapped multi-line text maps runs per line: given originalText 'ab\ncd', text identical, range {start:1,end:4,color:'red'}, expect [[{a,null},{b,red}],[{c,red},{d,null}]] (backgroundColor null everywhere); the \n is never part of a run

ranges survive a bound container's wrapping: given rectangle 90x75, Enter to edit its label, type 'Bid request timeout 120ms', select 20..25, stroke colour '#e03131', exit editor, expect label text contains '\n'; styleRanges [{start:20,end:25,color:'#e03131'}]; styled runs of getTextStyleLineRuns(text, originalText, styleRanges) concatenate to '120ms'

ranges survive a font family change: given styled text selected, actionChangeFontFamily with {currentItemFontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Nunito}, expect fontFamily changed and styleRanges deep-equal to before

undo and redo restore ranges: given text added with API.updateScene captureUpdate NEVER, then API.updateScene with newElementWith(text,{styleRanges:[{start:0,end:5,color:'#e03131'}]}) captureUpdate IMMEDIATELY, expect Keyboard.undo() gives styleRanges undefined (toBeUndefined); Keyboard.redo() gives [{start:0,end:5,color:'#e03131'}]

reconcile keeps the winning element's ranges intact: given local text version 3 with ranges A, remote copy version 4 with ranges B (and a second pair where local has the higher version), expect reconcileElements returns the remote element with exactly B in the first case and the local with exactly A in the second; no mixing

paste styles does not copy ranges onto another text: given styled text A (ranges set) copied with actionCopyStyles, plain text B selected, actionPasteStyles, expect B still has no styleRanges key while its strokeColor matches A

duplicate carries ranges: given styled text selected, Ctrl+D (Keyboard.withModifierKeys({ctrl:true}, () => Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.D))), expect the duplicate has styleRanges deep-equal to the original's
